sampling_unit: unit_id with at least one v4-eligible R5 target
seed_origin: secrets.token_hex(32), generated once before sampling; no outcome-based seed search
source_rng_seed: master_seed_hex + colon + resource_id; random.Random(string), default version-2 seeding
pool_order: lexicographically sorted unique unit_id within resource_id
draw: random.Random(source_seed).sample(sorted_pool,450); sort selected IDs only for export
